newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania OTC market slides, more falls seen ahead.
newsitem.headline: Romania OTC market slides, more falls seen ahead.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market fell on Monday as big investors await fresh lows in the prices of attractive stocks before buying, dealers said.

Independent index VAB-RASDAQ, computed by VANGUARD securities, slipped by 1.95 percent from the previous session to 3,438.96 points. Another unofficial index, the BIG-OTC compiled by BIG brokerage house, inched down by 2.96 percent to 2,502.46 points.
Operators saw the downtrend continuing over the next few days.
Oil refinery Arpechim was the main loser closing 3,000 lei weaker at 17,500 under strong selling pressure.
Plane maker IAR also lost 3,000 lei to close at 50,000 in light trading. Operators expected the stock to recover on Tuesday.
Cement makers stayed at centre-stage, with Romcim closing 1,500 lei stronger at 68,500 and Moldocim rising by 3,000 lei to 28,000.
Decliners outnumbered gainers 126 to 125, with 325 stocks unchanged.
Turnover drifted up to 11.9 billion lei from 7.36 billion last Friday, with 4.1 million shares changing hands.
